query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
  SUM(CASE WHEN family IS NOT NULL AND family != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_family,
  SUM(CASE WHEN family IS NULL OR family = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as without_family
FROM plants;
